faqs.question: What is real estate SEO?
faqs.answer: Real estate SEO is setting up your website and online profiles so Google shows them when buyers search for the projects, localities and services you sell. It focuses on project-name, locality and agent searches that portals don't serve well, and brings enquiries without paying per click for as long as the pages rank.

faqs.question: How does SEO for brokers work?
faqs.answer: SEO for brokers is mostly local SEO plus a small original website. Verify a Google Business Profile with the right category, build one page per locality you cover, write your own pages for the projects you sell instead of copying the developer, show your RERA agent number, and collect genuine reviews from every satisfied client.

faqs.question: What is local SEO for real estate agents?
faqs.answer: Local SEO for real estate agents means getting your Google Business Profile and website into map and "near me" results for your areas. Google ranks local results by relevance, distance and prominence, and says you cannot pay for a better local ranking. A complete, verified profile, consistent details and real reviews matter most.

faqs.question: Which real estate keywords should a builder target first?
faqs.answer: Start with your project and builder names, because people searching them are already interested and your own page should rank first. Next, target locality plus configuration searches such as "3 BHK in Gomti Nagar Extension", then agent searches won through Google Maps, and finally the questions buyers ask before they buy.

faqs.question: Can a small builder or broker outrank property portals?
faqs.answer: Rarely for broad searches such as "flats in Noida", where portals have years of authority. But a small builder or broker can win project-name, builder-name, specific locality and "property dealer in [area]" searches with separate, original pages for each project and area and a strong Google Business Profile.

faqs.question: How do I choose real estate SEO services in India?
faqs.answer: Pick a provider that works on project, locality and agent searches, sets up Search Console and your Business Profile in your own name, builds links honestly, and reports enquiries and site visits rather than only traffic. Avoid anyone who guarantees rankings; Google says no one can guarantee a number one position.

faqs.question: Is SEO being replaced by AI?
faqs.answer: No, but it is changing. Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode use Google's normal index, and ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot build answers from web pages they cite. Clear pages with plain-text facts, FAQs and consistent business details are more likely to be quoted, and buying-intent searches still send people to websites.

faqs.question: How long does real estate SEO take?
faqs.answer: Weeks for a new page to be indexed and months for positions to settle, longer for a brand-new website. Most builders run ads for a launch and build SEO alongside it, so organic enquiries take a growing share over time. Track progress monthly in Google Search Console and your lead sheet.

faqs.question: Should a channel partner copy the developer's project page?
faqs.answer: No. Google usually shows only one version of duplicate content, and it is often the developer's. Write your own page with your own details, your RERA agent number, site-visit help, comparisons with nearby projects and anything else you add for the buyer that the developer's page doesn't cover.
